case_title: RANIL IGNATIUS FERNANDO VS. SANJOT KHURANA

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $8,776.00 FILED BY FERNANDO, RANIL IGNATIUS AS TO DEFENDANT KHURANA, SANJOT ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-25-2020 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - FEE FOR SERVICE $75.00 - SERVED JUL-25-2020, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT KHURANA, SANJOT
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-25-2020 - CONTINUED ON THE COURT'S OWN MOTION AND CONDITION OF THE COURT CALENDAR TO JAN-14-2021 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506 (W.TRUPEK 506)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-14-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JAN-27-2021 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF RANIL IGNATIUS FERNANDO IS PRESENT. WITNESS FOR PLAINTIFF REX FERNANDO. DEFENDANT SANJOT KHURANA IS PRESENT (LATE). AT 09:15 THE COURT RECESSES, AND RESUMMED AT 09:45. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT. DEFENDANT SHALL PAY PLAINTIFF $2842.50. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE JAN-27-2021 IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCE AT THE HEARING THIS CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. COMMISSIONER: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER CASE CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506) JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
